subject.title: Feature: Handle Signal message edits (editMessage envelope)

question: For a Signal message edit, should OpenClaw replace the original inbound transcript entry, append an explicit edit event, or cancel and rerun the active turn when the edit changes an in-flight request?
rationale: The channel can expose the edit target timestamp, but choosing transcript semantics and active-run behavior changes user-visible context and response expectations across sessions.

options.title: Replace and mention-gate
options.body: Use the target timestamp to update the original context entry and suppress a new turn unless the corrected group message explicitly mentions the agent.

options.title: Append explicit edit events
options.body: Preserve both versions with structured edit metadata and make dispatch policy explicit, accepting more transcript complexity.

options.title: Broaden to cross-channel cancellation
options.body: Design a generic recall/edit-to-active-run cancellation contract first, then implement Signal against that shared seam.

recommendation.title: Replace and mention-gate
recommendation.body: Use the target timestamp to update the original context entry and suppress a new turn unless the corrected group message explicitly mentions the agent.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history places the central Signal inbound monitor and routing work with this contributor.
